% Canonical SCI-MAP v0.2 requirements. All 52 predecessor identities are
% preserved; the approved post-freeze dispositions are incorporated in place.
\newcommand{\SCIMapRequirements}{%
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-001}{Versioned authority}{The scientific contract version shall be \SCIMapContractVersion. The rendered document revision shall be recorded separately as \SCIMapDocumentRevision; changing layout or exposition alone shall not be represented as a new scientific contract version.}{Inspect both artifacts and their machine-readable provenance for distinct contract-version and document-revision fields.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-002}{Capability and realized PTC input}{The ordinary input shall be the realized SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed calibrated-\(x\) product \(z_i=Z_i^{\rm PTC}\), a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent detector-time quantity in the inherited top-of-atmosphere, point-source-equivalent \texttt{mJy/beam} convention with its exact originating fixed-nominal-beam identity. Neither that unit nor a STOKES token establishes Stokes~I. MAP has no CAL-to-MAP fallback, no inferred no-op PTC product, and no product when the required positive-rank PTC product is absent or PTC is disabled.}{Exercise exact realized PTC input, attempted CAL input, PTC-disabled and no-product routes, incompatible PTC generation, missing nominal-beam identity, and attempted Stokes-I promotion.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-003}{Exact occurrence identity}{Every candidate occurrence \(i\) shall bind observation, detector occurrence and UID, stable RTC output sample \(n\), exact PTC product/application generation, segment, and array/network/group as applicable. Sample time is an associated attribute. Input-column, row, and container positions are locators only and shall not establish identity or equality.}{Permute times, containers, rows, and columns while preserving or breaking the exact parent chain; products shall follow exact occurrence identity and reject inferred joins.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-004}{Producer facts and MAP admission}{SCI-MAP shall consume PTC-owned transformed-signal availability, output-retention disposition, coefficient family/value/typed availability, and coefficient/QC proposition without reinterpretation. The PTC coefficient/QC proposition passes only when the coefficient is requested, applicable, eligible, and realized under the exact PTC-owned coefficient/QC profile for the declared MAP-facing family. It does not grant MAP use. SCI-MAP shall separately apply the source-bound occurrence profile \SCIMapUpstreamProfile; the manifest-bound SCI-VAL Registry revision binds and VAL Core evaluates that MAP-authored policy but does not author it. The immutable r0.5 profile \SCIMapUpstreamProfileHistorical{} is historical, is not a compatibility alias, and shall not replace \SCIMapUpstreamProfile. Every fact, decision, cause, scope, and immutable reason remains separately typed.}{Toggle each producer fact and each of the four named fields independently; verify exact PTC coefficient/QC projection, separate MAP admission, preserved causes, source/profile-version rejection, and no rescue or universal producer-flag action.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-005}{Coordinate and projection authority}{MAP shall consume \SCIMapASTRTCGridProfile{} for the same stable RTC sample \(n\) and complete parent chain as \(z_i\); it shall never join by time, row, cardinality, or coordinate equality. MAP owns \(G_{pi}\) through \SCIMapOneHotProfile: the unique finite in-grid pixel whose cell contains the coordinate under half-open bounds contributes \(G_{pi}=1\), every other pixel has \(G_{pi}=0\), and an outer-upper-boundary or out-of-grid coordinate contributes nowhere. Fractional projection is deferred. AST may materialize the relation only when the artifact binds the AST parent and exact MAP plan.}{Test exact-parent joins, centers, lower and upper cell boundaries, outer extent, invalid coordinates, sum-over-pixel normalization on its in-grid domain, and prohibited wrap/clamp/fractional placement.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-006}{Ordinary coefficient status}{The ordinary route requires one explicitly selected PTC-owned MAP-facing analysis/gridding coefficient family satisfying SCI-PTC-REQ-052--055 and \SCIMapPTCMapBoundaryId. The admitted Registry \SCIMapPTCCoefficientRegistry{} contains \SCIMapPTCUniformFamily{}, whose exact supported value is dimensionless \(\gamma_i=\omega_i=1\), and grants MAP permission through \SCIMapPTCUniformHandoffProfile{}. Registration and permission do not select a family or realize a handoff. MAP shall use this family only after explicit selection; one immutable completed SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.5 transformed-product publication bound to the exact application, CAL parent, observation, and selection lineage and typed as a complete segment, complete scan, or bounded chunk wholly within one named scan or segment and one observation; exact target/payload/occurrence association; and a requested, applicable, eligible, realized profile evaluation under the admitted source and compatible binding generation. MAP does not reproduce, select, or infer the PTC-owned formula. An absent selection without an authorized mode default, unregistered family, incomplete PTC publication, missing or mismatched payload, unavailable coefficient/QC decision, or incompatible generation makes the affected route unavailable; there is no unity or alternate-family fallback. Structural availability remains distinct from finiteness. MAP alone classifies an authorized payload as finite positive, exact zero, negative finite, non-finite, or unrepresentable and applies only a matching finite strictly-positive value. The uniform family supplies no precision, sensitivity, loading, scatter, response, covariance, exposure, validity, optimality, or default meaning.}{Exercise the registered-but-unselected, selected-but-unpublished, missing/mismatched association, nonpassing four-axis evaluation, incompatible generation, and exact admitted uniform cases; verify producer QC, MAP admission, numerical classification, contribution, and every identity, support, lifecycle, uncertainty, and prohibited meaning separately.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-007}{Exposure lineage and accounting}{ALIGN-owned \(e_{\rm acq}\) and valid-original \(e_{\rm vo}\), in seconds, shall remain immutable on stable original occurrences through RTC/CAL/PTC. The products are normatively \texttt{upstream\_eligible\_original\_footprint\_exposure} and \texttt{retained\_original\_footprint\_exposure}. The shorter prose labels ``upstream-eligible exposure'' and ``retained exposure'' are explicit aliases for those products and no others. MAP shall deduplicate by exact observation, detector occurrence/UID, stable original/native occurrence, stable ALIGN slot, and ALIGN mapping generation; place each positive-\(e_{\rm vo}\) original exactly once through \SCIMapASTFootprintBoundaryId, its layered AST ALIGN-grid direction/tangent/continuous-pixel parent in the exact target MAP WCS, and \SCIMapOneHotProfile; and never use a descendant RTC-output coordinate. Geometry/pointing realization, frame, coordinate validity, boundary state, parent, and version are required. Upstream-eligible and retained exposure differ only by ancestor-population restriction. Causal influence, representative RTC occurrence, and original-footprint exposure remain separate. These exposure products are not complete temporal support, effective map integration time, precision, or normalized-map influence. Missing original-coordinate authority makes the affected exposure role unavailable. Invalid-original has \(e_{\rm vo}=0\); synthesis, replacement, donor reuse, overlapping filters, and decimation create no exposure. Boundary loss contributes nowhere. Coadd exposure unions atomically admitted observation-scoped original identities.}{Use one original influencing several descendants at different pixels, an original and descendants in different pixels, missing original coordinate, boundary loss, multiple maps sharing one original, distinct observations with identical coordinates, donor and synthesized descendants, and repeated lineage; verify exact own-coordinate placement, deduplication, and separate influence support.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-008}{Response information state}{Every valid \SCIMapBaseObservationRole{} product shall disclose its known MAP-local realized operator response \(A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\), including exact input/output domains, membership, projection, coefficient, support-row, WCS, parent, lifecycle, and limitations. MAP shall separately type upstream-conditioned fixed-state linear response, PTC full-procedure finite differences, and PTC+MAP re-resolved procedure response. An available fixed-state object shall also bind source domain, PTC-sample codomain, units, parents, response basis, and upstream limitations. Every numerical full-procedure \(\Delta\boldsymbol z_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}\), \(\Delta\boldsymbol m_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}\), or \(\Delta\boldsymbol m_{{\rm PTC+MAP}\text{-}{\rm RR}}\) shall bind the complete comparison-space record in \SCIMapComparisonSpaceDefinition. The PTC+MAP family reruns PTC and separately resolves \(\Pi_0\) and \(\Pi_+\), whose membership and \(\mathcal S_{\rm out}\) may differ; subtraction is unavailable without exact maps into one authorized common comparison domain. A whole-chain RTC-to-CAL-to-PTC-to-MAP response is reserved for a separately authorized complete study and is unavailable unless so established. Absent upstream response shall be reported as limited or unavailable without concealing the known MAP-local operator, invalidating an otherwise valid base map, fabricating a whole-chain identity, or prohibiting later analysis. A later response estimate or corrected map is a new immutable versioned product bound to the original MAP product and processing identity.}{Exercise MAP-local-known/upstream-unavailable, fixed-state, full-procedure common-domain and unavailable-domain cases, PTC+MAP re-resolved changing membership, companion-starting-at-MAP, partial, and attempted whole-chain cases; verify exact typing, maps and rows, application exactly once, complete signal membership, honest limitations, and no fabricated identity or implicit subtraction.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-009}{Immutable plan and lifecycle}{\SCIMapLifecycleDefinition{} The same ordered lifecycle shall bind the MAP plan, coefficient selection and application, projection, support policy, output plan, coadd plan, response and covariance requests, every independently requested product role, and \texttt{coverage\_cut}. \SCIMapAxisSeparationDefinition{} Disabled expert values remain inactive; one observation's resolved state shall not leak into another.}{Compare serialized states across two deliberately different observations; stop one before application and one after a terminal applied failure; verify ordered one-way provenance, absence of fabricated applied/realized products, exact applied-attempt failure, axis separation, and complete replacement.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-010}{Factored contribution predicate}{For each pixel, membership in \(\mathcal C_p\) shall be the conjunction of ten exact Boolean pass predicates derived from separately retained typed records: transformed-signal availability; PTC output retention; coefficient availability; PTC coefficient/QC proposition \(\operatorname{pass}_{\gamma,{\rm QC}}\); MAP upstream admission; AST coordinate validity; finite \(z_i\); finite strictly positive \(\gamma_i\); admitted projection/boundary relation; and MAP-local contribution plus required-companion predicates. Every VAL-evaluated gate retains named request, applicability, eligibility, and realization fields; only request=\texttt{requested}, applicability=\texttt{applicable}, eligibility=\texttt{eligible}, and realization=\texttt{realized} passes. Every other field combination is nonpassing with its exact cause, failure scope, and immutable reason retained. A structural source- or profile-binding failure is recorded only when that structural condition actually occurs; an ordinary nonpassing field value is not thereby a structural failure. Evaluation follows the ordered DAG: A structural identity/parent, generation, source/profile, producer availability, and decision-realization checks; B retrieval only of structurally admitted payloads and MAP classification of \(z_i\) and \(\gamma_i\); C AST validity, one-hot boundary/placement, and MAP-local required companions; D membership construction; E accumulation. All gates pass before payload arithmetic. Reading an authorized payload to classify it is not arithmetic, and excluded non-finite values never contaminate accumulation. T/F/U/C or four-field records shall never be conjoined directly; no numeric-zero mask represents exclusion.}{Vary one gate, each of the four named fields, source-binding failure, and knowledge state at a time; compare the typed record, Boolean projection, exact DAG stage, membership, cause/scope, and immutable reason; place NaN/Inf behind structurally excluded and admitted cases to distinguish safe classification from arithmetic contamination.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-011}{Ordinary accumulators}{On the fixed contribution set, SCI-MAP shall accumulate \(N_p=\sum_i a_{pi}z_i\), \(Q_p=\sum_i a_{pi}\), and, when available for the identical membership, \(K_p=\sum_i a_{pi}k_i\), where \(a_{pi}=G_{pi}\gamma_i>0\).}{Use one-pixel and one-hot hand calculations and compare accumulators before normalization; fractional projection is not authorized in v0.2.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-012}{Normalized publication}{The scientific normalized output vector shall contain exactly the rows \(p\in\mathcal S_{\rm out}\) authorized by the applicable effective support policy. On those rows finite \(Q_p>0\) gives \(\widehat m_p=N_p/Q_p\), and an available response companion gives \(\widehat k_p=K_p/Q_p\). No unsupported row, zero-filled value, or sentinel is a normalized scientific output or measured zero.}{Exercise positive, exact-zero, near-zero, overflowed, and non-finite aggregates; compare exact row identity and inspect any nonauthoritative storage slots.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-013}{Accumulator interpretation}{The numerator is a pre-normalized accumulator and \(Q_p\) is a normalization fact by default. Neither shall be labeled a sky estimator, inverse variance, confidence, coverage, or significance without the separately required conditions.}{Audit schema, metadata, API types, and labels for every numerator and normalization representation.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-014}{Constant preservation}{With fixed admitted membership and positive coefficients, the ordinary estimator shall preserve a constant admitted sample input on every row in its exact support-authorized output set. This prediction shall not create rows outside that set or be promoted to compact-source, extended-source, integrated-flux, absolute-offset, or astrometric fidelity.}{Map constant fixtures with uniform and unequal coefficients; compare exact output-row membership, then confirm that stronger response claims remain separately gated.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-015}{Projection-specific estimand}{The authorized base projection is exactly \SCIMapOneHotProfile; it preserves unity over the finite in-grid domain and has explicit half-open boundary loss. Fractional projection, diagonal weighted least squares, and conservation across a finite boundary are outside this branch until separately authorized.}{Use containing-pixel and outer-boundary fixtures; attempt fractional or WLS substitution and require method rejection.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-016}{One exact MAP operator for linear companions}{For one selected immutable realized plan \(\Pi\), \(A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\equiv A_{\rm out}\equiv D_{Q,{\rm out}}^{-1}J_{\rm out}G\Omega\) is the only MAP operator and its complete realized identity is the MAP-local operator-response disclosure. Its identity binds the exact admitted PTC-sample input domain, support-authorized output-row domain, coefficient family/generation, one-hot projection plan, support policy, target WCS/grid, immutable parents, and lifecycle generation. Signal, fixed-state response, conditional covariance, an available realized PTC-grid response companion, and fixed noise realizations shall use that same operator, membership, placement, coefficient state, and output rows. A PTC full-procedure difference with MAP state fixed may use the same operator only after its baseline and perturbed products, common PTC-sample comparison domain, exact input maps, common output-row comparison domain, and exact output maps are authorized; equality to \(A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\Delta\boldsymbol z\) requires those exact common domains rather than array shape. A PTC-grid companion begins at MAP and receives the operator exactly once, never \(H_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}\) again. Physical original-footprint exposure instead uses unique originals and each original's own AST ALIGN-grid coordinate; causal influence is not a linear exposure companion.}{Trace all named uses coefficient by coefficient; compare operator, comparison-domain, row-map, and parent identities; verify complete MAP-local disclosure and exactly-once application; reject shape-, intersection-, interpolation-, and position-inferred differences; and separately trace original-footprint placement.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-017}{Realized response claim}{A stored kernel may be called a realized fixed-state response to template \(\boldsymbol\tau\) only when its exact sample parent satisfies \(\boldsymbol k=H_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}\boldsymbol\tau\) and the support-restricted map satisfies \(\widehat{\boldsymbol k}_{\rm out}=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}H_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}\boldsymbol\tau=R_{{\rm fixed},\Theta}\boldsymbol\tau\) on exactly the signal rows. A PTC full-procedure finite difference \(\Delta\boldsymbol z_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}\) and either map difference shall retain its distinct family identity and the complete comparison-space record, including both product identities, quantity/unit, rows, frames/WCS, reference/gauge/null state, supports, bases, common domain and exact two maps, unmatched-row treatment, perturbation and finite-difference convention, state transition, availability, and cause. \(\Delta\mathcal S_{{\rm PTC}\text{-}{\rm FP}}\) records state change but never authorizes numerical subtraction. Otherwise the response is a tracer, separately typed discontinuity, limited, or unavailable.}{Inject a declared fixed-state template, comparable and noncomparable PTC full-procedure perturbations, a PTC+MAP re-resolved perturbation with different \(\Pi\) and rows, and a mismatched tracer; verify family, complete comparison record, exact maps and rows, state differences, and no implicit fill, intersection, association, interpolation, reprojection, or gauge alignment.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-018}{Absolute-offset mode}{SCI-MAP v0.2 shall apply no signal-centering operation: \(L=I\). Coaddition shall not subtract a mean, remove a constant mode, or recenter a source; any upstream loss of that mode shall remain explicit in response and provenance.}{Use a constant-offset fixture and inspect both the mapped value and recorded upstream response/null-mode state.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-019}{Conditional covariance}{When a declared PTC-domain covariance \(N_{\rm PTC}\) is available for the exact fixed membership and state \(\Theta\), MAP shall propagate it as \(C_{m,{\rm out}}=A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}N_{\rm PTC}A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}^{\mathsf T}\), retaining consequential off-diagonal terms on the exact operator domains. The equation is complete only on the declared available domain. Missing, limited, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable terms remain typed and are never zero-filled or interpreted as independence; absence of a complete model does not invalidate the signal map.}{Compare a small exact propagation and honest partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, and unavailable states on identical operator and row membership.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-020}{When normalization is precision}{Normalization may be called marginal inverse variance only when the exact selected \(\gamma\) family is calibrated true inverse variance, selected errors are independent on the asserted domain, and \(\sum_i\gamma_i(G_{pi}^2-G_{pi})=0\). One-hot geometry alone does not prove the coefficient premise.}{Test one-hot geometry with both proven inverse-variance and nonprecision coefficient families.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-021}{Formal diagonal weight}{When its assumptions hold, \(\phi_p=Q_p^2/\sum_iG_{pi}^2\gamma_i\) is the formal marginal inverse variance. It remains distinct from \(Q_p\), support-restricted precision \(C_{m,{\rm out}}^+\), exposure, hits, and empirical statistical weight.}{Compute and label every object for an authorized one-hot fixture and a correlated counterexample.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-022}{Covariance and nuisance disclosure}{The bundle shall report what uncertainty or covariance information it actually provides, its meaning, domain, assumptions, and limitations, and whether fuller information is persisted, lineage-resolvable, summarized, incomplete, or unavailable. It shall list omitted correlations and nuisance terms; absence of a complete covariance model shall not invalidate the map or prohibit later analysis, and unavailable information shall not be set to zero. A later covariance estimate may be attached only as a new versioned product bound to the original MAP product and processing identity.}{Inspect every representation state, prevent promotion of normalization, hits, or diagnostic weight to covariance, and verify derivative-product binding without rewriting the original claim.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-023}{Data-derived state}{If membership, coefficients, response, or geometry are estimated or selected from the same data, the displayed linear expectation and covariance shall remain explicitly conditional; unconditional bias or covariance requires a named joint model or resampling result outside this fixed-state claim.}{Use metadata cases for fixed and data-derived state and verify that unconditional labels appear only with separately admitted evidence.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-024}{No significance promotion}{Signal multiplied by the square root of merely formal weight shall be labeled formal standardized signal, not \texttt{sig2noise} or empirical significance. \SCIMapNOIOwnershipStatement{} In particular, MAP shall not equate this quantity with NOI's conditional marginal second moment or standardized signal, and no future calibrated significance product is inferred.}{Attempt each prohibited relabeling through all public representations; compare \(Q\), formal conditional precision, complete conditional covariance, the exact NOI marginal-second-moment and standardized-signal roles, and a hypothetical separately authorized significance role; require distinct identities and claims.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-025}{Distinct map facts}{Every base/unfiltered MAP bundle shall separately represent AST-geometric incidence, MAP-route-candidate incidence, estimator-admitted contribution, admitted-observation count, \texttt{upstream\_eligible\_original\_footprint\_exposure}, \texttt{retained\_original\_footprint\_exposure}, numerical-normalization support, science-policy support, and MAP-local base-product scientific validity. No fact or downstream eligibility decision shall become authority for another.}{Construct cases in which each pair differs and verify separately typed identities and immutable ownership.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-026}{Incidence layers}{AST-geometric incidence records valid coordinate placement independent of signal availability; MAP-route-candidate incidence additionally requires the exact realized PTC route and occurrence-level upstream admission; estimator contribution additionally requires all remaining gates in \(\mathcal C_p\). The one-hot touch convention counts the unique containing pixel only.}{Use coordinate-valid/signal-unavailable, route-ineligible, zero-coefficient, and admitted occurrences and compare all three populations.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-027}{Estimator contributions}{Estimator-admitted contributions shall count exactly \(i\in\mathcal C_p\). A candidate ineligible under the exact MAP admission or contribution policy for its preserved cause, or with unavailable/conflicting required state, zero/negative/non-finite coefficient, non-finite signal, or out-of-grid projection, contributes nowhere; no producer flag implies a universal action.}{Compare exact counts with an independently evaluated profile and factored-gate oracle while preserving cause and decision scope.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-028}{Admitted observation count}{For coadds, admitted observation count shall count complete observation bundles contributing at the pixel and shall not be confused with sample hits or observation attempts.}{Use one complete, one unsupported, and one rejected observation bundle and verify the per-pixel count.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-029}{Upstream-eligible original-footprint exposure}{MAP \texttt{upstream\_eligible\_original\_footprint\_exposure} shall union and deduplicate exact positive-\(e_{\rm vo}\) original occurrences that are ancestors of route candidates admitted by \SCIMapUpstreamProfile. Each original is placed once by its own exact AST coordinate and the one-hot half-open rule; it is not placed at every descendant coordinate. The exposure population precedes coefficient positivity and MAP-local numerical rejection. Missing original-coordinate or lineage authority makes this exposure role unavailable.}{Use one original influencing several candidates at different pixels, plus an eligible zero-coefficient candidate; verify one own-coordinate exposure placement, separate influence edges, and no precision promotion.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-030}{Retained original-footprint exposure}{MAP \texttt{retained\_original\_footprint\_exposure} shall use the same original-occurrence key and own-coordinate placement as REQ-029, restricted to originals that are ancestors of estimator-admitted members. Overlapping filters, decimation, replacement, synthesis, and multiple descendants do not duplicate seconds. Coadded exposure shall union observation-scoped original identities after atomic coadd admission; one original can occupy at most one pixel under the base one-hot family, or none after boundary loss. Neither exposure is precision.}{Use overlapping observation lineage, multiple descendants, mixed admission, donor reuse, and boundary loss; compare exact original-key unions, pixel placement, and coadd sums.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-031}{Adopted threshold selector}{For each declared support-policy population, sort its finite strictly positive normalization coefficients \(Q_p\); for count \(N>0\), select zero-based \(k=\lfloor(\lfloor0.75N\rfloor+N)/2\rfloor\) and \(Q_\star=Q_{(k)}\); for empty input set \(Q_\star=0\). The exact population and policy identities and each reached requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized state/value of dimensionless \(c=\texttt{coverage\_cut}\) shall be retained; a completed realization contains all five. Pre-application admission shall check the exact observation-resolved value. Application shall bind that value to one support-policy attempt; realization shall later bind only what was produced. The exact Boolean plan fact \texttt{coverage\_cut\_above\_one\_override\_requested} shall bind request identity, authorized owner or profile, scope, each reached lifecycle stage, exact value, cause, and provenance. It has no applied/realized record before application and no realized record after an applied terminal failure. The scalar shall be finite and nonnegative. Exact zero requests no relative cut while finite strictly-positive \(Q_p\) remains mandatory. Values \(0<c\le1\) are the ordinary recommended range. A value \(c>1\) is admissible only when that independently authorized fact is true for the same resolved value and scope; the number cannot authorize itself and may honestly produce empty science support. Negative, non-finite, missing, or unrepresentable values shall fail before support-row construction, application, or required-product mutation. No universal numerical default is established.}{Check \(N=0\) and small \(N\) values around every integer-index transition against the exact zero-based formula; verify each reached stage and all five on completed realization, pre-application use of the resolved value, absence of future-stage placeholders, applied-terminal failure behavior, exact-zero and ordinary endpoints, independently authorized above-one override with same-value/scope matching, self-authorization rejection, possible empty support, and preconstruction nonmutation for every invalid state.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-032}{Separate support predicates}{Only after the effective plan and exact observation-resolved cut pass REQ-031 shall application bind \(c_{\rm applied}=c_{\rm observation\_resolved}\) for one support-policy attempt. Numerical normalization support shall then require finite positive \(Q_p\ge Q_\star c_{\rm applied}/10\), and science-policy support shall independently require finite positive \(Q_p\ge Q_\star c_{\rm applied}\). Both comparisons are inclusive and use the exact declared population and inherited order statistic. At \(c=0\), no relative threshold excludes a row, but no zero, negative, non-finite, or absent \(Q_p\) is restored. An authorized expert \(c>1\) may leave the science-support set empty. These thresholds are an operational relative-support policy and imply no exposure, precision, significance, response, completeness, or physical optimality. Neither support state establishes final validity or precision; no realized value is required to authorize this pre-application check.}{Exercise values below, exactly at, and above both thresholds for empty and nonempty populations; distinguish normalization from science support; verify resolved-to-applied equality, exact-zero behavior, no self-authorizing above-one value, and no use of \(c_{\rm realized}\) as a prerequisite.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-033}{MAP-local base-product validity}{One MAP-local base-product scientific-validity state shall require membership in the exact support-authorized row set, exact admitted PTC and AST parents, passing MAP contribution/support policy, finite normalized signal, and absence of an applicable MAP-product failure. Explicitly limited or unavailable response/covariance does not alone invalidate the map. Retained storage, finite payload, coefficient, exposure, incidence, normalization, or downstream-local eligibility cannot establish or rewrite MAP validity.}{Use truth-table fixtures separating producer state, MAP admission, response/covariance disclosure, base validity, and later use-local eligibility.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-034}{Classify before arithmetic}{Only structurally admitted payloads shall be retrieved and safely classified for finiteness/sign before membership construction. All required gates shall pass before payload arithmetic. Multiplication by zero, masking after accumulation, or sanitizing a non-finite aggregate shall not substitute for admission.}{Place NaN and Inf payloads behind structural false and true predicates; verify no unauthorized read, exact numerical classification when authorized, no contamination, diagnostics, and failure scope.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-035}{Exceptional contribution states}{Zero coefficient shall be noncontributing, a low positive coefficient shall follow the explicit adopted policy, negative or non-finite ordinary coefficients shall be invalid, and an out-of-bounds projection shall contribute nowhere. Each cause shall remain distinguishable.}{Run one-cause-at-a-time fixtures and inspect cause-specific states plus unchanged neighboring pixels.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-036}{Complete observation bundle and roles}{\SCIMapProductRoleDefinition{} A \SCIMapBaseObservationRole{} shall exist as one immutable ordered logical bundle before coaddition. It contains signal, numerator, normalization identity, complete MAP-local realized operator identity, honest upstream-response and uncertainty/covariance identity and status, the distinct facts in REQ-025, exposure lineage/accounting identity, unit and exact nominal-beam parent, complete AST frame/WCS, shape/indexing, estimator/projection/profile identities, PTC removed-component/additive-reference/null-space state, every actually reached stage of the five-stage MAP lifecycle, exact PTC/AST parentage, and product identity. It may remain valid when a stronger numerical upstream response or complete covariance is unavailable. Independently requested \SCIMapResponseObservationRole{} and \SCIMapCovarianceObservationRole{} products shall each parent the exact base observation, bind their own five-stage lifecycle, and require respectively every named numerical response object or every named within-observation covariance block. Physical persistence is separately controlled by the effective output plan.}{Request each observation role independently; remove or alter each required identity/companion; distinguish absent declarations from honest unavailable states; verify role-specific failure without base-parent mutation; and verify identical scientific content and identity for in-memory and faithfully persisted forms.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-037}{Role-qualified atomic coadd admission}{A complete observation bundle shall pass every compatibility check and only the companion checks required by the exact selected product role and \SCIMapCoaddProfile{} before any coadd-owned state changes. Under \SCIMapBaseCoaddRole{}, unavailable or basis-incompatible response and incomplete covariance do not alter signal membership and do not reject an otherwise compatible base bundle; their exact identities, states, and causes remain. A required companion incompatibility is atomically decisive only for \SCIMapResponseCoaddRole{} or \SCIMapCovarianceCoaddRole{} as applicable. If an exact base coadd parent already exists, such an incompatibility blocks the stronger role for that parent and never selects a subset. A separately requested stronger-role admission may reject an observation only before constructing its own explicitly identified base/signal parent. Every rejection leaves all affected numerators, normalizations, counts, exposure, response, validity, provenance, and product cardinality unchanged.}{Snapshot all role-owned and base-parent state; inject one base fact, response, and covariance incompatibility at a time; verify role-specific admission, exact pre-mutation rejection, unchanged base membership, and no companion-only subset.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-038}{Centered integer common grid}{A canonical target grid may be requested and made immutable before observation-map construction. Observation maps constructed on that exact grid, or otherwise compatible observation/coadd shapes, shall use exact centered-integer embedding: shape differences are nonnegative and even in each axis, and the corresponding integer offset maps reference pixels to the same world coordinate. A later crop is a newly identified row-selected product with immutable parent and lineage; it shall not relabel the parent or make it retrospectively compatible. Fractional shift, post-hoc pad, reprojection, interpolation, wrapping, implicit recentering, mosaicking, and a different sky grid are outside this estimator.}{Test preconstruction target-grid requests, every parity/sign case and WCS reference-pixel relation, exact integer embedding, a separately identified post-hoc crop, attempted parent relabeling, and each excluded grid-changing operation.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-039}{Ordinary coadd estimator}{The exact v0.2 family \SCIMapUniformCoaddProfile, owned by MAP, assigns dimensionless \(u_{op}=1\) to every row of each bundle eligible and realized under the VAL-governed aggregate profile \SCIMapCoaddProfile. The VAL request/applicability/eligibility/realization fields remain distinct from the five-stage MAP coadd lifecycle. The coefficient is an equal-observation coefficient, not precision or inverse variance. Each of \SCIMapBaseCoaddRole{}, \SCIMapResponseCoaddRole{}, and \SCIMapCovarianceCoaddRole{} is independently requestable, has its own exact base parent and lifecycle, and uses identical centered-integer equal-observation signal arithmetic for its admitted ordered membership. On exact row identities, \(N^c_p=\sum_o u_{op}\widehat m_{op}\), \(Q^c_p=\sum_o u_{op}\), and \(\widehat s_p=N^c_p/Q^c_p\) is published only on \(\mathcal S^c_{\rm out}\). Conforming in-memory and persisted bundles have identical admission, identities, arithmetic, and result; storage route is not a scientific weighting or eligibility fact.}{Evaluate all four VAL fields separately from all MAP lifecycle stages; independently request all coadd roles; use one and two observations from in-memory and persisted conforming routes; verify exact parent/membership, arithmetic equality, and rejection of precision labels.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-040}{Coadd companions and unavailable response}{The stacked signal vector \(\widehat{\boldsymbol m}_{\rm obs}\) shall carry explicit observation-row identities; \(B_{\rm out}\) is the exact centered-integer equal-observation averaging operator; and \(T_{\rm obs}\) is the stacked compatible fixed-state observation-response object on those same domains. \SCIMapBaseCoaddRole{} requires every admitted member's complete base bundle and all response identities/statuses, but permits unavailable or basis-incompatible response with unchanged numerical signal membership. It shall then publish coadd response unavailable with exact cause, never a hidden response subset, zero companion, or assumed compatibility. \SCIMapResponseCoaddRole{} parents one exact base coadd with identical ordered membership and requires every numerical response object named by the role with exact compatible source domain, basis, class, unit, normalization, parent, WCS/grid, and row identity. If the requirement fails for an existing parent, the stronger role is unavailable and the parent is unchanged. Any separately selected response-bearing admission that rejects a member shall construct a separately identified base/signal parent and reject before any of its state mutates. Exposure and count follow that selected admission, with exposure's unique-original placement.}{Use complete, basis-incompatible, limited, and unavailable responses under both roles; verify unchanged base membership and unavailable response, exact stronger-role parent identity, no subset of an existing parent, and atomic admission for a separately identified response-bearing request.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-041}{Coadd covariance and precision}{\(\boldsymbol\Sigma^{\rm obs}\) shall be the block covariance matrix on exact stacked observation-row identities with every available within- and cross-observation block explicitly located. \SCIMapBaseCoaddRole{} requires covariance identities/statuses and permits partial, symbolic, summarized, lineage-resolvable, or unavailable state. \SCIMapCovarianceCoaddRole{} parents one exact base coadd with identical ordered membership and requires every named within- and cross-observation block before MAP may publish \(C_{c,{\rm out}}=B_{\rm out}\boldsymbol\Sigma^{\rm obs}B_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\). Missing blocks are unknown and block only this stronger role; they are never zero or independence. If a block is absent for an existing parent, no subset is selected and the base coadd remains unchanged. Any separately selected covariance-qualified admission that rejects a member shall construct its own separately identified base/signal parent before mutation. The uniform observation coefficient is not precision.}{Use complete within/cross blocks and every missing-block state under both roles; verify exact propagation only for the complete stronger role, unchanged base membership and validity, no subset, and exact parent/role identity.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-042}{Correlated-GLS boundary}{A correlated minimum-variance solution using \((\boldsymbol\Sigma^{\rm obs}_p)^{-1}\boldsymbol 1\) may require negative combination coefficients and therefore belongs to a separately authorized correlated-GLS branch, not the ordinary positive-coefficient coadd. The token \(K_p\) remains exclusively the MAP response/kernel accumulator and never names a covariance matrix.}{Use positive- and negative-correlation covariance matrices that distinguish ordinary weighting from the GLS benchmark; require method and notation identity to remain explicit.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-043}{Minimum product identity}{Every observation and coadd product shall identify one exact product-role token from the six-role Registry; its independent request and every actually reached stage of the five-stage MAP lifecycle; exact base parent and ordered membership; external observation/coadd, array/group, occurrence, and row domains; estimator and coefficient families; MAP-local operator and upstream-conditioned response/covariance states; signal unit and fixed-nominal-beam parent; complete AST frame/WCS and WCS-generation identity; preconstruction target-grid request where applicable; grid/projection/boundary; MAP profiles; exact PTC product/application and coefficient generations; exposure convention; logical-bundle and plan-controlled persistence state; parentage; causes; and product identity. Any numerical full-procedure response additionally binds its complete comparison-space record; coverage policy binds its typed above-one override record. No STOKES token supplies quantity authority. Scientific identity shall be durable without prescribing a persistence format.}{Round-trip every role, lifecycle, parent, membership, comparison-space, and override identity through in-memory and persisted representations; detect collisions or generation mixing; and reject a bare token, storage route, or serialization convention as scientific authority.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-044}{Frames and units}{MAP shall bind the complete frame identity delivered by \SCIMapASTRTCGridProfile: exact source/target frame, reference system (including ICRS or FK5/J2000 as actually declared), equinox/epoch, time scale, site/model state, TAN topology, WCS, axis order, signs, handedness, and degree-valued science axes. MAP shall not equate J2000, FK5, ICRS, apparent, observed, or unrefracted frames by name or default. Signal/response units are \texttt{mJy/beam} with exact nominal-beam identity; covariance has its square.}{Inspect complete frame and unit/beam identity and require cross-frame, ambiguous-frame, cross-unit, or cross-beam coadd rejection.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-045}{WCS and index persistence}{Full-precision typed or sidecar WCS shall be the lossless admission and provenance authority. \SCIMapWCSComparisonDefinition{} The 0.1-arcsec bound is only the maximum over that exact preregistered finite population; it is not a continuum or global-sky maximum. Exact axis sign, handedness, orientation, and centered-integer shape/reference-pixel relations remain required independently of the numerical bound.}{Evaluate every preregistered center and outer-boundary vertex with the stated index relation, frame, WCS generation, binary64 spherical metric, and invalid-point rule; calculate the exact finite-population maximum and separately verify every orientation invariant.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-046}{Lifecycle-bound provenance}{Every MAP plan, coefficient selection/application, projection, support policy, output plan, coadd plan, response/covariance request, product role, and coverage policy shall record each reached requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, and realized identity in order. The record shall include each reached exact \texttt{coverage\_cut} stage, with all five included for completed realization; the typed \texttt{coverage\_cut\_above\_one\_override\_requested} identity, authority/profile, scope, value, cause, provenance, and binding to every reached stage of the five-stage lifecycle; exact PTC/AST/boundary/profile and admitted coefficient Registry/family/handoff generations; every typed gate's independent request/applicability/eligibility/realization fields plus Boolean projection, immutable reason, cause, failure scope, and DAG stage; exact product-role and base-parent identities; admitted contributions/bundles; the complete MAP-local operator \(A_{{\rm MAP},\Pi}\), accumulators, and row domains; unique-original exposure facts; PTC additive-reference/removed/null states; response family and complete comparison-space/state-transition record; covariance state; WCS comparison population/generation; centered-integer offsets; persistence state; required products; and failures. No applied or realized record shall be fabricated before application; a terminal post-application failure retains the applied attempt without a realized product.}{Reconstruct each reached lifecycle stage, role/parent, row-selected operator, cut/override transition, coefficient handoff, exposure population, gate projection, comparison-space map, WCS population, logical/persisted relation, and typed unavailable or terminal-failure state from provenance alone.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-047}{Failure scope and atomicity}{An invalid required input, unauthorized above-one cut, incompatible bundle, unrepresentable finite aggregate, unrepresentable coordinate/index conversion, missing companion required by the exact selected role, or failed required publication shall propagate at its declared contribution, pixel, observation-admission, or complete-product scope and shall fail before the affected live state changes. A pre-application failure creates no applied or realized record. A failure after application retains the exact applied attempt and terminal cause without fabricating a realized product or completion marker. Base-role response/covariance unavailability permitted by REQ-037--041 is an honest state, not a role-independent atomic rejection.}{Inject each failure class under every product role at its exact boundary; inspect scope, lifecycle, diagnostics, nonmutation, unchanged base parent, and absence of false application, realization, or completion.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-048}{Required observation products}{A complete logical \SCIMapBaseObservationRole{} bundle shall exist before coaddition. Persisted per-observation products are the normal scientific expectation and shall be published whenever the effective v0.2 output plan designates them required; every required publication shall complete or the declared operation fails without a completion claim. A plan may instead permit a fully in-memory route. A coadd-only entry may consume persisted conforming observation bundles without rerunning upstream processing. In-memory and persisted routes shall use identical logical admission, arithmetic, role and base-parent identity, five-stage lifecycle, and provenance. Optional nonpublication does not imply that the logical observation product did not exist, and this MAP rule does not waive PTC's upstream atomic required-publication obligations.}{Exercise required-publication success/failure, optional in-memory nonpublication, and coadd-only persisted input for each requested role; verify identical base bundle, parent, admission, arithmetic, lifecycle and provenance, exact failure propagation, no misleading realization/completion, and unchanged upstream PTC duties.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-049}{Immutable base parent}{Every stronger observation/coadd role and downstream transformation shall preserve the exact resolvable base/unfiltered MAP-bundle or base-coadd identity, ordered membership, lifecycle, and MAP-local base-product validity. A later local validity/eligibility decision may differ for its named use but shall not rewrite MAP validity, alter the original claims, sever parentage, or select a hidden subset of an existing base parent. Later response or covariance estimates are new versioned products.}{Create stronger roles and later locally eligible products over MAP-invalid and MAP-valid parents; verify exact membership, both validity states, parentage, and original claims remain immutable.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-050}{Complete consumer boundary}{No consumer shall receive a bare signal plane as a scientifically complete map. The boundary shall include exact product role, request, base parent and membership; quantity and nominal-beam identity; estimator/normalization/coefficient/profile identity; honest response class/state and uncertainty/covariance disclosure; distinct map and exposure facts; PTC additive-reference/removed-component/null-space state; exact frame/WCS, shape/indexing, all reached lifecycle stages, parentage, dependency versions, comparison-space record when applicable, and failures. Later analyses choose their own exact claim requirements and may attach honest versioned response/covariance products; MAP does not own their eligibility. \SCIMapNOIOwnershipStatement{}}{Exercise every role and claims with missing required facts, including NOI-related claims and analyses that explicitly accept limitations; verify fail-closed claim scope, exact parent/membership, and no rewrite of MAP validity.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-051}{Same fixed noise operator}{An admitted noise realization may be described as using the same map/coadd operator only when eligibility, projection, grouping, coefficients, normalization, exact support-authorized row selection, boundary, and atomic coadd admission are fixed or identically prescribed. Re-estimation from the randomized data defines a different named estimator.}{Propagate fixed deterministic vectors through signal and realization paths and compare row identities and operator coefficients, not filenames or shapes.}\par
\SCIMapRequirement{SCI-MAP-REQ-052}{Method and claim separation}{Pointing and OOF may be registered consumers of the exact ordinary MAP gridding operator only when their inputs satisfy this operator contract. Reuse grants no mode-specific WCS/frame, source model, fitting, response interpretation, output, default, or qualification authority; an unsupplied mode profile remains unavailable. This authority shall not otherwise be applied by analogy to JINC, maximum-likelihood mapmaking, OOF residual transfer, reprojection, filtering, empirical noise, fitting, Beammap inference, feedback, Stokes Q/U, measured-R mapmaking, or other units. Independent inspection, modification, experimentation, and proposal remain unrestricted, while an altered scientific identity or official claim requires an explicit versioned successor and evidence appropriate to that claim. Algebraic contract correctness, engineering conformance, representation/response fidelity, observational performance, and production readiness shall remain separate claims.}{Exercise conforming and nonconforming Pointing/OOF operator requests, missing mode profiles, each prohibited method/claim promotion, and an independently changed support algorithm; verify exact operator reuse boundaries, unavailable unsupplied authority, versioned identity, and independent claim-state fields.}\par
